Name: Tiny Farmhouse Fixes
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4]Tiny Farmhouse Fixes is a small patch that fixes and improves several minor issues in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22990]Tiny Farmhouse 1.6[/url].[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=3]Tiny Farmhouse 1.6 is still fully usable without this mod. This patch is intended as a small quality-of-life improvement rather than an essential fix.[/size][/color]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=3]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50043]T's Core[/url] v1.9.0 or later.[/size][/color][/b]

Fixes & Improvements
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where spouses could disappear because no kitchen standing location was defined.[/*]
[*]Prevented furniture from being placed on the tile where spouses stand in the kitchen.[/*]
[*]Expanded the kitchen interaction area, which was previously limited to a single tile.[/*]
[*]Fixed the cellar warp so that entering from the left staircase correctly leads to the left side instead of the right.[/*]
[*]Removed unsupported renovations from the renovation menu.[/*]
[*]Adjusted renovation preview areas to correctly match the areas being renovated.[/*]
[/list]
